subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this remain an umbrella issue until both the Control UI reply-metadata contract and final fallback delivery contract are resolved, or should maintainers split/redirect it to narrower canonical items now?
rationale: Current main has partial implementation pieces, but deciding the permanent `chat.send`/agent-context reply contract and the final-fallback user-visible semantics is a product/API boundary choice rather than a safe autonomous cleanup.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI acceptance umbrella while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Split To Canonicals
options.body: Move the reply metadata requirement to the active reply-context work and the no-output requirement to the final-fallback issue, preserving this issue as linked context before closing later.

options.title: Sponsor Control UI Protocol Work
options.body: Ask for a dedicated Control UI `chat.send` reply-target protocol proposal if maintainers want the browser surface to move independently from channel-generic reply metadata.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI acceptance umbrella while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source blame and issue timeline point to him around the Control UI, gateway protocol, and agent-context surfaces where the product boundary would land.
